question: Can Jev separate contradiction from complementary and from unrelated on real decision-style statements, including pairs where lexical overlap points the wrong way?

typed_question.decision_rule: argmax of the returned probability map

primary_metrics.contradiction_recall: of the 10 contradiction pairs, the fraction judged contradiction
primary_metrics.false_suppression_rate: of the 20 non-contradiction pairs, the fraction judged contradiction

gate.decision: PASS only if both hold; otherwise STOP this direction

secondary_metrics: confidence calibration by label (descriptive only, n=30)

controls.temperature_or_sampling: provider default; not settable by the client

limitations: Pairs were authored by one person; labels are not independently adjudicated.
Statements are drawn from this project's own domains, so vocabulary overlap with the model's training data is unknown.
n=30 is too small for calibration; Brier/ECE are descriptive only.
A pass does not establish production value; it only clears the gate for the next step.
